bio.text: Rick Lopes was elected in 2020 to represent the 6th Senate District, which covers Berlin, New Britain and parts of Farmington.
He previously represented the 24th Assembly District in New Britain, to which he was first elected in 2012.
Lopes worked at the State Capitol from 2003 to 2011 as legislative aide to Sen. Don DeFronzo and has run a property management and maintenance business since 1993.
He holds two bachelor's degrees, in English literature and sociology, and a Master of Social Work from UConn.
